## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, deps, housekeeping
- [ ] `refactor` — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature

## How tested

- [ ] `colcon build` passes
- [ ] Verified in Isaac Sim (scene loads, robot behaves as expected)
- [ ] Topics / TF checked in RViz (`ros2 topic list`, `ros2 topic echo`, TF tree)
- [ ] N/A — docs-only change

<!-- Add any extra detail: domain id used, specific topics, commands run. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat(navigation): add Nav2 bringup`)
- [ ] Docs updated — `MASTER_PLAN.md` and/or `docs/FASE*_GUIA_*.md` if this changes the plan
- [ ] No stray build artifacts committed (`build/`, `install/`, `log/`, generated meshes)
- [ ] Branch named per convention (`feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/`, `chore/`, `refactor/`)
